workload: principal_axes on 1_000_000 seeded float64 points; peak VmRSS added during the call, inputs excluded, one fresh process per sample
notes: The implementation materializes points - mean, a temporary the same size as the input, then forms a 3x3 Gram matrix. The docstring says this copy is not memory-optimal. A blocked covariance computes the same matrix with a small workspace and can drop about 24 MiB here. Five fresh processes, median of peak RSS delta. No open PR edits points.py. Open PR #9335 adds DataObject.principal_axes in dataobject.py and calls this function; it does not change it. Commits since 2026-10-13 in this file are #9482 (casts on other helpers) and prose-only #9402/#9400. dexhunter/pyvista PRs are only #9478, which edits cells.py _variable_size_cells. Not deprecated or being moved.

workload: 4x4 rotation+translation of 1_000_000 float32 points; peak VmRSS added during the call, inputs excluded, one fresh process per sample
notes: The 4x4 path does np.empty((N, 4)) in float64 and a (1, 4, N) matmul even when the points are float32, so the homogeneous pad and the product are full-size temporaries (about 60 MiB of this peak). Applying the 3x3 block and the translation separately keeps one output array. transformations.py has no commit since 2026-10-13 and no open PR. dexhunter #9478 does not touch it. The direct test covers 3x3, 4x4, and inplace scale and passed. Not deprecated.

workload: NumPy-to-VTK conversion of 100_000 ASCII labels; peak increase in sys.getallocatedblocks while the call holds arr.tolist()
notes: convert_string_array builds a Python list of every string with tolist() before vtkStringArray.SetValue, so all 100k strings are live together. Streaming SetValue from the array drops that peak by about 100k blocks. The scalar-string path is deprecated; this workload is a 1-D array, which is the supported path. Open PRs that touch arrays.py do not edit this function: #9271 inserts active-array helpers after vtkmatrix_from_array, and #9541 changes _SerializedDictArray.popitem. Merged since 2026-10-13 (#9482, #9480, #9402, #9400, #9429) change other signatures or prose. The string-shape behavior landed in #9114 on 2026-09-06, outside the window. dexhunter #9478 is cells.py only. Open issue #1162 is a 2021 non-ASCII table report; this function already rejects non-ASCII and is not being moved.

workload: Edge lengths of a seeded 1_000_000-triangle PolyData; one untimed warmup, then one call with GC disabled
notes: For equal-sized cells the function gathers an (N, npts, 3) coordinate block and fancy-indexes both endpoints of every edge before the norm. On one million triangles that is about 221 ms, and dropping those intermediate gathers is a plausible save above 10 ms. The only commit to this file since 2026-10-13 is #9481, which renames annotation types and does not change the algorithm. No open PR touches the file. dexhunter #9478 does not. tests/core/test_cell_lengths.py: 23 passed, including sphere, hex, structured, image, and mixed cells. Not deprecated.
